prerequisites: Basics in digital signal processing, for example the course ELEC-C5232 Digital Signal Processing

learning_outcomes.text: After the course students can descibe essential phenomena, methods and applications of sound and speech processing.
Students can apply them and basic tools of signal processing to implement sound and speech processing algorithms.
Students can apply basics of real time programming in sound and signal processing implementations.

syllabus_topics: Sound and speech processing methods and applications, like digital filters and oscillators
Room acoustics and binaural audio technology
Functioning of the speech production mechanism and main features of speech signal
Fundamentals of speech analysis and speech feature extraction
